(labels ((thread-form (form)
           (when (consp form)
             (if (eq (car form) 'sb-thread:make-thread) form
                 (loop for part in form thereis (thread-form part))))))
  (dolist (path '("spikes/out/preflight-parallel-publication/collect-R2.lisp"
                  "spikes/out/preflight-parallel-publication/audit-R3.lisp"))
    (with-standard-io-syntax
      (let ((*read-eval* nil) (*package* (find-package :cl-user)) (eof (gensym)) (forms nil))
        (with-open-file (stream path :direction :input)
          (loop for form = (read stream nil eof) until (eq form eof) do (push form forms)))
        (setf forms (nreverse forms))
        (let* ((definition (find "PARALLEL-MAP-FOUR" forms :test #'equal
                                :key (lambda (form) (and (consp form) (eq 'defun (first form))
                                                         (symbol-name (second form))))))
               (thread (and definition (thread-form definition))))
          (assert (and thread (= 4 (length thread)) (eq :name (third thread))
                       (eq 'lambda (first (second thread)))))
          (assert (and (consp (car (last forms))) (eq 'let (first (car (last forms))))))
        (format t "READ-EVAL NIL / EOF PASS: ~A (~D top-level forms); MAKE-THREAD :name outside lambda.~%"
                path (length forms))))))
